title: NFT Everywhere
tagline: Make all NFT fuild between blockchains, move your NFT easely from chain to chain
description:
NFT are attached to the chain they have been created. That make their usage restricted because they are hundreds of chains with various functionalities that the NFT owner can't access. The idea is to give the possibility to the user, as a simple drag and drop, to move the NFT to a different chain.
Once logged in into the interface, the user have access to his NFT, have information about the chain : gas fee, speed, privacy, ... and he can move the NFT to the other chain.
To make it simpler there is an integrated faucet for testnet.
how_its_made:
There are 4 package, 
- contract that is a generic NFT solidity contract and the builder and code generator for easy use.
- ethers-network : lots of functionality to complete ethers with transaction managers, and network information, javascript generic contract handler, ...
- backend : Node express : user login, contract deployement and faucet
- frontend : React web interface for the user
